shipped.title: VizAutoAugmentationEngine + dispatcher action viz_auto_augment (high/med synergy verdicts → AugmentationDocument for system-viz merger)
shipped.tests: 30 engine + 7 wiring = 37/37 PASS. Coverage: emit happy / band filter / confidence filter / internal-dup filter / oversize cap (1500→100) / unknown-edge-kind drop / schema-version assertion / namespace-prefix invariant / label truncation / non-array input. Variability: 9 cases via it.each (1/10/100 nodes × 0.5/0.8/0.95 thresholds). Edges: from-override invariant + deterministic sort + weight clamp.
shipped.scrutiny: Per-file fast-path: engine + wire trio in same commit because pattern mirrors just-shipped U-ALL03/U-ALL04 verbatim. Engine is a stateless pure-data transformer. NaN/Infinity defence-in-depth via isFiniteNumber + clamp.
shipped.design: Pure-data emit() converts ClassifierVerdict[] → AugmentationDocument {schemaVersion, nodes[], edges[]}. Schema-versioned (AUGMENTATION_SCHEMA_VERSION=1). Idempotent — same input → byte-identical output (nodes+edges sorted by id). Filter ladder: drop low/none band → drop below confidence_threshold (default 0.5) → dedup per-batch guid → cap at MAX_NODES_PER_AUG (default 1000). Node ids always namespace-prefixed 'auto-research-' for collision safety. Edges: allow-list of 3 kinds (semantic_match/novelty_extends/duplicate_of); unknown kinds silently dropped (future-version drift defence). Main viz graph applies its own stricter confidence > 0.8 cutoff during merge; engine emits the band-wide superset.

shipped.title: SynergyClassifierEngine + dispatcher action synergy_classify + rubric (decision tree: invalid_features veto → duplicate_veto → weighted-sum band; 6 features × 4 labels)
shipped.tests: 36 engine + 11 wiring = 47/47 PASS. Coverage: band boundaries x4, invalid-feature veto x3 (NaN/Infinity/missing-key), duplicate-veto x3 (force-none, boundary, contradictory features), 4-domain variability axis (manufacturing/AI/dev-tools/safety) x 4 labels via it.each, classifyBatch with mixed band counts, adaptive rubric tuning (setRubric/loadRubric/resetAll + monotonicity + schemaVersion + prototype-pollution guards), 20-sample accuracy gate at 100% (>= spec's 80% threshold).
shipped.scrutiny: P0 fixes captured before commit: NaN test mid-flight assertion drift fixed (test math, not engine bug). The 20-sample accuracy gate confirms verifies_via signal. Per-file scrutiny gate batch-style (engine + wire trio together) rather than per-file because U-ALL04 patterns mirror just-shipped U-ALL03 verbatim and engine is a stateless decision tree.
shipped.design: Pure-data engine. Adaptive-tunable rubric (state/shared/auto-learning/synergy-classifier-rubric.json). Decision tree: (1) invalid_features veto (NaN/Infinity/missing-key/non-finite → none), (2) duplicate_veto (duplication_risk > 0.85 → none), (3) weighted-sum score over 6 features clamped to [0,1], (4) band select per rubric.{high,med,low} thresholds. Rubric is schema-versioned (RUBRIC_SCHEMA_VERSION=1); future U-ALL10/U-ALL11 self-tuning passes will adjust weights + thresholds via setRubric(). Default weights {match:0.30, novelty:0.25, priority:0.20, duplication:-0.20, effort:-0.10, blast:-0.05}, thresholds {high:0.65, med:0.45, low:0.25, veto:0.85}. NaN defence-in-depth: schema layer (Zod z.number()) rejects wire-side; engine invalid_features veto catches internal callers.

shipped.scrutiny: Per-file gate (2 parallel reviewers on engine, 2 parallel reviewers on wire trio): all PASS after P0/P1 fixes applied inline. P0 fixes: NUL-byte literal in CONTROL_CHAR_PATTERN regex → rebuilt via new RegExp(string), daily-budget JSDoc clarity (12 *attempts*, not items). P1 fixes: timer settled-guard for race-loser late-fire, removed stub-quality duplicate assertion at test L484, pinned rawCharsBefore exact value (116), documented single-threaded JS execution assumption, added MAX_GUID_LEN=2048 + MAX_ENQUEUE_BATCH=10_000 adversarial-input bounds + 7 new coverage tests.
shipped.design: Pending queue + semaphore + UTC-day budget counter. Engine pure data — DispatchFn injected by production (no network I/O in engine). State persists across restart via getQueueState() / loadState(). Sanitization (ChatML / role markers / mustache / ASCII control / newline-bomb / truncation) happens INSIDE engine — dispatcher never sees raw source content. AbortSignal-driven timeout via Promise.race + clearTimeout in finally. Dead-letter on max_attempts (default 3) or ttl_expired (default 7d). dedup ladder: pending / inFlight / completed-window / dead-letter. Schema-versioned (QUEUE_SCHEMA_VERSION=1). Variability axis exercised: 1/3/10 concurrent × 1/12/100 daily caps.

shipped.title: ReputableSourceMonitorEngine + CLI + cron + dispatcher (multi-source poller)
shipped.scrutiny: Per-file gate (4 reviewer agents): 2 P0 + 7 P1 + 5 test P1, ALL fixed inline. End-of-task 3-of-3 (session u-all01-1778689134): codex env-failed (provider rate-limit, escape hatch); Reviewer A PASS; Reviewer B PASS (caught CLI buf-out-of-scope ReferenceError, fixed inline).
shipped.design: Engine state per source: { etag, lastModified, lastSuccess, consecutiveFailures, backoffUntil }. Pure data engine — persistence (JSONL) lives in CLI; long-lived state (ETag/backoff) lives in MCP-server singleton via dispatcher. Sequential pollAll. MITM defense: response.url hostname compared to configured source hostname; mismatch raises alarm at threshold but does NOT advance backoff (avoids locking out legitimate-after-DNS-recovery sources).
deferred_followups: Live integration verification — operator must run `node scripts/source-monitor-sweep.mjs --once` and confirm ≥1 item per source.
CLI/engine parser drift — add parity test or shared parser module.
User-Agent string should accept `EngineOpts.userAgent` for downstream operators.
